title: Dhugaa Baatuu Cimaa
intro: Seenaan gadi fagoon kan mul’atu yoo ta’u, murtoo hin raafamne hawaasni tokko abbaa irree guddaa keessatti qabu mul’isa. Seenaan isaanii aarsaa isa dhumaa wajjin yeroo wal qunnaman illee amantiif ragaa ta’ee tajaajila. Seenaan kun humna amantiin cunqursaa humnaa ol taʼe irratti qabu nu yaadachiisa.
clues: Nuti garee seenaan keenya suuraa gabaabaa humna guddaa qabdu keessatti irra deebi’amee kan himamu, ari’atama irraa akeekkachiisu turre.
Bulchaa Waaqa Tokkicha, Gooftaa Teessoo, Galatamaa ta’etti amanuu keenya hundee irraa buqqisuu barbaadu nu mudate.
Qormaanni hamaan boolla guddaa lafa keessa qotame tokko nu mudate.
Daa’imman dabalatee amantoonni boolla sana keessaa ibidda boba’aa ta’etti yeroo darbataman ilaalaa turre.
Warri nu dhiphisan gocha isaaniitiin kan abaaraman yoo ta’u, nuti immoo jabina keenyaaf badhaasni guddaan nutti dhaga’ameera.
Bulchaan amantaa keenya dhaamsuuf yaaliin godhe, Rabbii waan hundaaf ragaa ta’e biratti akka wareegamtootaatti bakka keenya jabeessuu qofa.

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Qabeenyi hangana hin jedhamne kennameefii ture

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
